title: Add Spot the Fake to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Spot the Fake](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-spot-the-fake) to games
- A real-or-AI guessing game. Each round shows two photos or two sentences, one real (a Wikimedia Commons photo or a Wikipedia sentence) and one generated with Pollinations. Pick the fake before the tim

Fixes #15749, fixes #15725

gist.headline: Spot the synthetic one
gist.blurb: Spot the Fake joins the games list. Two photos or sentences enter; one came from Pollinations. Polli has suspicions.
gist.summary: Added Spot the Fake to the games list, a guessing game that pairs a Wikimedia Commons photo or Wikipedia sentence with a Pollinations-generated counterpart.
gist.impact: Players can test whether they can pick the generated photo or sentence from each pair.
gist.visual_concept: Spot the Fake is a real-versus-generated guessing game, with no mascot or logo specified. Show two picture-and-text clue cards on a cozy game table; Polli, wearing a tiny detective hat, studies them while a friendly CRT robot holds a magnifying glass. Pixel flowers and code-plants connect the game to the pollinations garden.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art game nook, two clue cards sit side by side on a table as a small bee detective studies them and a cheerful CRT monitor robot offers a magnifying glass; pixel flowers and code-plants grow nearby, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, mint, and peach tones.
